rationale: Menghapus correctly means “to delete/remove” in Indonesian. In Malaysian Malay, memadam is semantically related, but standard transitive usage for deleting digital data is better represented by memadamkan; DBP technology terminology uses memadamkan data/content. The contrast is not a false friend, though the current Malaysian form may teach a less idiomatic collocation.
